puzzleText: You text back the correct PIN number to Crooked Kenny, and suddenly your phone DINGS! again. This time its an email. The sending address is from gr3yh4t@hacker.com It reads: ------------------------------- Subject: Meet Me Here aT the tOp of Western Nook at Home Around Lonely Lanes at Sunset, don't Trust Anyone Though I Obvously already kNow ------------------------------- It doesn't make sense. You don't know of any western nooks or lonely lanes. No, it must be a code. The real meeting place must be encoded into the message somehow. But how? Where is the meeting place?
hint: "It is a CAPITAL mistake to theorise without data" - Sherlock Holmes
title: Theorise Without Data
